libs.note: BH-9472 (BH-9285 Fix 4): a ci-red fix round runs the failing CI test files on the box (CI locale, throwaway Postgres, CI_LOCAL_BUDGET_S) before the agent call. Green here = NOT REPRODUCED: no agent call, no push, one PR comment, one counted fix round. Red here = the round runs and pushes only after the same files pass on its tree. bin/blocked-resolver.d/bh-9472-fixround-repro.sh calls it; tests/fixround-repro.bh-9472-test.sh drives it.

knobs.note: 1 = a ci-red fix round reproduces the failing CI test before the agent call and pushes only after it passes here. 0 = off: every fix round runs as before. Any other answer is this default. Read by bin/lib/fixround-repro.sh (frr_on) with no literal.

The tail of each failed CI job log that is read for FAIL lines. A FAIL line before the tail is not read: that job then names no test file and the round runs as before (never a false NOT REPRODUCED). Read by bin/lib/fixround-repro.sh (_frr_log_max_kb); 2048 is its documented last fallback.

The tail of a still-red repro-verify log that goes into the round's verify output (fix-verify.txt, which the next round's brief reads). Read by bin/lib/fixround-repro.sh (frr_verify_tail_bytes); 4000 is its documented last fallback.
